title: Figra: A browser-based Excel add-in for publication-quality scientific visualization
description: Figra is a Microsoft Excel Office Add-in that enables researchers to generate publication-quality scientific figures directly from spreadsheet data using ggplot2 and R, executed client-side via WebAssembly (webR). No R installation is required. Figra supports 18 chart types, integrated statistical analysis (t-test, ANOVA, Kruskal-Wallis, post-hoc tests), IC50 dose-response curve fitting, linear-quadratic clonogenic survival curves, and exports both reproduction and educational R code to support reproducibility and learning.
